label: copy phase of long sequences (L>=8), from the 3rd output on
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires on original-phase steps, at the delimiter, or on the first copy output, and is almost absent for L <= 6. Rate rises steeply with sequence length (L=9: 14% of steps, 73% of activation mass; L=8: 22% of mass), and is highest at recall_idx 3 and at the last outputs of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 8: 38% rate). Within that window, firing is sparse and depends on the input token: 3, o, x, g, z and q have about twice the rate of other tokens. It also rises with the number of digits in the original sequence. The predicate captures 95% of activation mass on dev, but precision is low (0.27) because the unit fires on only some copy steps, and a token-set refinement does not reach a clean F1 (best about 0.52).
